name: Summit AZ - Local SEO AEO and AI Research 2026-10-10
body:
> Research · Summit Az · 2026-10-10

# Summary
A research brief (nothing applied) on how Summit can rank in Google Maps, Google AI answers and AI assistants. Built from Kim's lesson notes plus current studies and Google documentation. All three channels reward the same five things: one consistent business identity everywhere, fresh reviews on more than one platform, one strong specific page per service, pages that answer real questions directly, and mentions or links from real local sources.

# Key findings
- Local SEO: relevance, distance, prominence. Map pack top factors include primary category, distance, address in the searched city and being open at search time; local organic favors a dedicated service page, city relevance and quality links. Mesa is Summit's strongest map city; other cities are won mainly through local organic. Do not add keywords to the GBP name.
- AEO: Google says no special trick or schema or llms.txt is needed; AI Overviews split questions into sub-questions and cite deeper pages (only 38% of citations from top-10 pages per Ahrefs). Lead with a 40 to 60 word answer under question H2s. GBP Q&A was retired, so on-site FAQs matter more.
- AI assistants: ChatGPT leans on Yelp for local answers; Google AI features lean on GBP; plumber queries cite GBP 54% and Yelp 13.8%. Being on local "best of" lists is a top factor. Reddit citations dropped sharply in 2026. Summit: 0 of 10 non-branded prompts, 1.8% AI visibility.
- Reviews: recency matters most; reply to every review; keywords in reviews do not help; incentives, gating and quotas are banned.
- Lessons check: keep the legitimate tactics (complete GBP, master NAP doc, top 15 to 20 citations, local links, under 50% similarity between city pages, real photos); reject rank-and-rent tactics, review gating, paid reviews, CTR manipulation and PBNs. Toxic PBN links found in Aug 2026 still have no disavow.

# Suggested order (for Kim to approve)
- Phase 1 identity: read-only listings audit (Yelp, Bing, Apple, BBB, Angi, Facebook, Nextdoor and others), fix entity conflicts in Rank Math, short list for Scott (reviews, unapproved GBP services, review asks).
- Phase 2 pages: Mesa page for "plumber mesa az", continue one-at-a-time rewrites, question pages from GSC and People Also Ask.
- Phase 3 prominence: local links (chamber, sponsorships, suppliers, news), decide the PBN disavow, track AI visibility monthly.
- Workflow for existing pages (Kim, Oct 10): audit performance, analyze SERP, mark sections Keep/Improve/Add/Remove for Kim, optimize, publish and review after 14 days.
